tasks.spec: Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo — edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash; leave changes uncommitted (the check exports a patch). No MCP, no network, no skills; do not ask for approval — nobody is watching. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files. YOU OWN EXACTLY: factory/surface_compiler.py (create), factory/graphs.py (extend qa only), tests/test_surface_compiler.py (create). Modify nothing else. MISSION — plan Task 1 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-05-p2-compiled-surface.md (present in this worktree; its 'Frozen interfaces' section and marker grammar are binding; TDD order): build factory/surface_compiler.py, a DEPARTMENT-AGNOSTIC generator+checker for the clief-notes department surface compiled from departments/<dept>/subgraphs.json. generate(dept_dir) writes: AGENTS.md (generated routing summary + invariants inside markers, human region below — under 50 generated lines), CLAUDE.md (fully generated, exactly 3 lines, pointing at AGENTS.md), ROUTER.md (fully generated: a table mapping each workspace folder to its subgraph id + node count + concept_refs, plus the unknown-route STOP sentence: a task matching no workspace STOPS rather than guessing), and per subgraph in order of appearance NN_<slug>/ (NN 2-digit starting 01, slug = subgraph id lowercased with the SG- prefix removed and hyphens turned to underscores) containing CONTEXT.md (generated sections: Purpose from id+concept_refs, Node chain as the ordered impl list, Inputs labeled L3 (charter.yaml, references/) and L4 (state/ paths), Outputs, Verify pointer to the matching procedural-graph.md row; then the human region) and references/README.md (generated half-life rule text: every reference file carries Last-updated and a half-life; expired references are stale context). Marker grammar EXACT: '<!-- GENERATED:BEGIN section=<name> source=subgraphs.json -->' ... '<!-- GENERATED:END section=<name> -->'. Everything outside marker pairs is human-owned and MUST survive regeneration byte-for-byte. Generated regions are deterministic (no timestamps) so generate is idempotent. Empty human regions render as '_No owner notes yet._' — never TBD/TODO anywhere in generated output. check_surface(dept_dir) returns [] when <dept_dir>/ROUTER.md does not exist (unadopted department); else regenerates in memory and compares ONLY the marker-bounded regions of each file, returning '<relpath>: <reason>' failures for missing files, drifted generated regions, mangled or missing markers, or an NN_ folder on disk that is not in the topology; an unreadable subgraphs.json is a FAIL, never a silent skip. CLI: 'python3 -m factory.surface_compiler generate --dept-dir <path>' (rc 0, rc 1 on refusal) and '... check --dept-dir <path>' (rc 0 clean, rc 1 with one failure per line). WIRE factory/graphs.py qa(): load surface_compiler by file path with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location (NO package import — mirror how loopfactory.py _load()s modules), add result['surface'] = check_surface(dept_dir), and include it in the ok computation; change nothing else in graphs.py. TESTS: create tests/test_surface_compiler.py implementing ALL EIGHT tests named in plan Task 1 Step 1, using the fixture described there (tmp dept dir; subgraphs.json with SG-ALPHA two nodes, SG-BETA one node, one untraced_allowed entry). Watch every test fail RED first (module absent), implement, then the green gate: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" python3 -m pytest tests/test_surface_compiler.py tests/test_hopper_sensor.py -v — the hopper test exercises the full validate path through graphs.qa and must not regress.
tasks.check: bash /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/ringer/loop-brain-reconcile/checks/p2_check.sh p2-surface-compiler 'tests/test_surface_compiler.py tests/test_hopper_sensor.py' factory/surface_compiler.py factory/graphs.py tests/test_surface_compiler.py
tasks.verified: Department-agnostic surface generator with exact marker grammar, idempotent regeneration preserving human prose, drift/mangled-marker/extra-folder detection, qa() surface key wired; all eight plan tests plus the validate-path regression green; patch touches only the three owned files.
